claims.claim: Dispach native scores 125/125 on five of the eleven models compared with other harnesses, and 99–100% on eight of fourteen models

claims.claim: Matches or beats Hermes 0.19.0 on 8 of 11 models, and costs the least of the three harnesses on 10 of 11 (level with Hermes on GPT-6.1 Sol)
claims.scope: Same tasks, isolation and pinned providers for all three harnesses
claims.limitation: Rival arms measured 2026-10-22/23, Dispach on 2026-10-23; the 95% intervals of every Dispach–Hermes pair overlap, gpt-oss-20b only just (70–84% against 82–93%)

claims.claim: NLT ahead of native: qwen3.5:9b 94.6% vs 91.9%, deepseek-chat 97.3% vs 86.5%, deepseek-reasoner 91.9% vs 89.2%
claims.scope: 37 fixtures, one model call each, routing + argument coercion, temperature 0
claims.limitation: No tool is executed. The qwen margin is **one fixture**. qwen NLT has a 2.7% critical rate against native's 0.0%

claims.claim: Native ties or beats NLT on every model on multi-turn tool work; NLT falls to 50–68% on Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 26B-A4B and GPT-6 Luna

claims.claim: +14.9pp accuracy, 93% fewer critical errors, −25% tokens; +24 to +43pp on small models
claims.evidence: Somma, Plante & Premji, 2026 replication of Johnson et al. 2025, [arXiv 2607.03953](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03953), 14 models, 8,560 trials
claims.limitation: Preprint. Frontier models (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) show smaller or reversed gains. Our own eval cannot test the critical-error claim. **Not reproduced on multi-turn work:** in `evals/harness/runs/sweep-552660a/`, native tied or beat NLT on 13 of 14 models, NLT 37–62% on five
